verdict.rationale: Devin's core interface is conversational/natural-language: tagging it in Slack/Teams about a bug, asking it to tackle tickets, and its embedded IDE are all described as a 'conversational user interface' driven by plain-language requests rather than rigid commands. This spans multiple surfaces (chat, Slack, CLI, API) reinforcing broad natural-language operability. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification that natural-language commands reliably produce correct results (community threads focus on overall task success rate/skepticism rather than confirming or denying the NL interface itself).
